messages.subject: [Roxygen-devel] roxygen package not available on R-forge / svn package broken
messages.subject_clean: [Roxygen-devel] roxygen package not available on R-forge / svn package broken
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

the roxygen devel package is still not available on R-forge,
and the package available via svn is broken -- when building the
package, I get the following error lines:

!pdfTeX error: pdflatex (file
pseudoprime/inst/doc/fermat.test-callgraph.pdf):
cannot find image file
 ==> Fatal error occurred, no output PDF file produced!
make: *** [roxygen.pdf] Fehler 70
Fehler in buildVignettes(dir = ".") : Ausf?hren von 'make ' fehlgeschlagen
Zus?tzlich: Warnmeldungen:
1: In graphviz(subcalls) :
  Omitting call-less call-graph for ?fermat.test?.
2: In graphviz(subcalls) :
  Omitting call-less call-graph for ?fermat.test?.

I assume that this error also is the reason for the package not being
available for download.

Thanks for your work,
regards,
Daniel

messages.body_plain:
Hi, 

I install the library roxygen but I was unable to use the command 

R CMD roxygen 

I have to install manually the script roxygen in 

/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/bin 

I'm using a IMac with Mac OS X 10.5.8 

Serge Iovleff
